newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen Wien takes off in Vienna.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen Wien takes off in Vienna.

text.p: Shares in Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien AG climbed 8.53 percent on Monday, lifted by demand from foreign investors.
At 1110 GMT Flughafen stood 42.20 schillings up at 537.20 and traders said the share was poised to break through mild resistance at 540-545 schillings.
"There are enormous buy orders from abroad. Funds are taking an interest in the stock," a dealer said.

Flughafen shares had dipped to a year low of 473 schillings on November 21. "The reversal was not unexpected but the extent of the rally was unforeseen," a trader said. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
